title: Crüger to Müller, August 1623
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller of August 1623, written at Danzig, thanking him for writings of Kepler's that Müller had sent. Crüger quotes an unnamed Italian on Kepler; the 1927 editors suggest Magini or Galileo, with a query. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. J. 31). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 108.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Crüger thanks Müller for Kepler's latest writings, which, as an Italian said, are as marvellous as the man, and which carry him out of himself whenever he reads them.

notes.note: The 1927 editors' guess. Giovanni Antonio Magini of Bologna died in 1617.
